postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][0] != output[j][0] or output[i][1] != output[j][1] for i in range(n) for j in range(i))
postconditions.description: All knights are in different cells.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if (output[i][0] - output[j][0])**2 + (output[i][1] - output[j][1])**2 <= 2) >= floor(n**2 / 10)
postconditions.description: The final number of knights is at least floor(n**2 / 10).
